get_cfg_clone: get a cloned CfgNode config object for the Habitat simulator robot with default sensor and agent settings
configure_simulator_scene: set the SCENE_ID and PHYSICS_CONFIG_FILE on the simulator config to load a specific Habitat scene
configure_sensor_poses: set the POSES list on the agent sensor config to adjust camera x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw values
configure_sensor_resolutions: set the RESOLUTIONS list on the agent sensor config to change the RGB and depth camera pixel dimensions
configure_robot_components: set HAS_ARM, HAS_BASE, HAS_CAMERA, HAS_GRIPPER flags on the config to enable or disable robot components
